verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs confirm native import support for Evernote (ENEX), Roam (JSON), and Markdown files, three of the four sources named in the story, plus Apple Notes and Workflowy. However, Notion import is not mentioned anywhere in the import/export documentation, and there is no explicit confirmation that internal links or attachments are preserved through the import process for any of these formats. Missing for 10: Notion import support, explicit evidence that links and attachments (not just note text) survive import.
